note_history.note: Claim received 2024-03-16. Initial photographs show significant water damage to ground floor. Adjuster assigned for field inspection.

Field investigation 2024-03-17: water ingress confirmed as external flooding. Millbrook Creek overflowed following 72-hour rainfall event per local authority report EA-2024-0315. This is flood damage (Clause 4.2b), not internal plumbing failure. Flood exclusion applies.
Fire reported at insured premises on 2024-04-02. Fire service attended. Claim submitted next day.

Site inspection 2024-04-04: Fire investigation unit has opened an arson inquiry (case FI-2024-0112). Accelerant traces detected at two ignition points. Criminal acts exclusion (Clause 8.1) is under consideration pending investigation outcome. Senior review recommended.
Arson confirmed by FIU report dated 2024-04-09. Criminal-acts exclusion (Clause 8.1) applies. No coverage payable. Refer to legal for subrogation review.
RTA reported 2024-02-27. Vehicle total-loss. Third-party damage also claimed. Awaiting police report.

Police report TS-2024-0487 received 2024-03-01: driver blood-alcohol concentration was 0.18 at time of collision (legal limit 0.08). DUI charge filed. Policy exclusion for intoxicated driving (Clause 6.3) applies. Claim not eligible for payment.
Theft reported 2024-05-09. Office broken into overnight. Laptop, monitor and mobile phone stolen. Police report attached.
Police report confirmed. Security footage shows forced entry. Items match policy schedule. No exclusions identified. Standard theft claim, eligible for payment less excess.
Hailstorm 2024-06-20 caused roof damage. Multiple tiles cracked. Claim submitted 2024-06-22.

Roof inspection confirms hail impact on 34 tiles and skylight frame. Damage is structural, not cosmetic. Weather data confirms severe hailstorm event in area. No pre-existing damage noted. Eligible for full repair cost less excess.
Graffiti found on exterior walls. Repair quotes obtained. Claim submitted.

Site visit confirmed spray-paint graffiti across three exterior panels and front entrance door. Owner is not the perpetrator. Tenant exclusion not applicable (owner-occupied property). Repair estimate reasonable. Approved less excess.
Burst pipe in upstairs bathroom caused ceiling collapse below. Claim submitted with repair quotes.

Internal pipe failure confirmed — no flood involvement. Ceiling and flooring in two rooms damaged. Total repair estimate GBP 9500. Policy sub-limit for internal water damage is GBP 8100. Payable amount: GBP 8100 - GBP 500 excess = GBP 7600. Partial payment applies.
Storm caused large oak tree to fall on garden fence and shed. Claim submitted with photos.

Arborist report confirms tree was healthy and showed no prior disease. Damage caused by storm wind gusts (100+ km/h recorded locally). No known-risk exclusion applies. Repair estimate reviewed and verified. Eligible less excess.
Lightning strike caused surge damage to home electronics. TV, router and two computers affected. Claim submitted.

Lightning event confirmed by meteorological data. Insured has whole-home surge protector installed, which is in spec. Sub-limit for electronics per event is GBP 2300. Four items totalling GBP 2700 claimed; payable capped at GBP 2300. After GBP 250 excess: GBP 2050. Partial payment applies.
Vehicle stolen from driveway overnight. No keyfob signal detected. Police report filed. CCTV from neighbour shows masked individuals.

Police report confirmed. Vehicle was attended (key inside house, locked). No negligent-security exclusion applies. CCTV corroborates theft. Total loss value agreed at GBP 18500. Eligible for full amount less excess.
